rec.name: Competitor Comparison Table (Us vs. Competitors)
rec.status: Draft — basic mockup created, launch not confirmed

what.text: A feature-comparison table that sets the brand (highlighted 'Wir'/'We' column) against two competitors across about 7 feature rows. Each cell shows a green check or a red cross. Each column has a logo/icon slot at the top. The table is meant to sit inside a master comparison landing page ('Brand vs. Competitor'), built on the current PDP and with one image per content section.

why.text: Side-by-side comparison lets shoppers who are already weighing alternatives see the differences at a glance. The brand's column is highlighted, and it is the only one with a check in every row. This anchors the brand as the complete choice, reduces perceived risk, and makes unique selling points (A/B-tested, expert-built, free updates, support) concrete rather than claimed. Check/cross icons are processed faster than paragraphs of copy.

how.text: Build as a table section with a label column plus 3 value columns. Make the first column visually dominant with a bright accent background, rounded corners, and extra height so it protrudes above and below the rows. Use a logo/icon slot and title in the column header. Rows are dark cards with bold feature labels, with green check or red cross icons centered in each column. Rows and per-cell values (yes/no) should be editable in the theme editor. The brand column should be checked in every row, and the competitors should be filled in honestly. Place it on a master landing page, with one image per content section around it.

items: Highlight color for the brand column
Check and cross icon colors (green / red)

dependencies.text: No apps or metafields strictly needed if rows and cells are theme-editor blocks. If the table is reused across several competitor pages, a metaobject per competitor would help. Needs competitor logos/images, which the comments say are still undecided (real photos vs. illustrations/icons). The surrounding master landing page (Sectionfy vs. sectionheroes.de, lionsbranding.com, section.store) is a separate work item.

items: Conversion rate of comparison landing page
Click-through from table to PDP or CTA
Bounce rate on the comparison page
Revenue per visitor vs. the standard PDP

images.caption: Comparison table mockup: highlighted brand column ('Wir') against two competitor columns, 7 feature rows with check/cross icons.
Layout cues: protruding accent-colored brand column, logo slots in the header, dark row cards, green check and red cross icons.
